about.title: About
body: This site is a simple space to draw Lenormand cards, read their meaning, and keep track of your own readings over time.

Lenormand is read differently from Tarot: cards are combined and read together, building a short narrative rather than standing alone. The spreads here — a Daily Draw, a Three Cards chain, and a Five Cards spread anchored on the centre — are meant to keep that in view.
Everything you draw stays on your own device; nothing is sent anywhere. Use it for reflection and fun rather than as a substitute for professional advice.

footer.disclaimer: For entertainment purposes only. Not a substitute for professional, legal, financial, or medical advice.
